pieces.Text: When the bolt ace hits a living creature with a crossbow attack, she can spend 1 grit point as a free action to have that attack deal extra bleed damage. The amount of bleed damage is equal to the bolt ace's Dexterity modifier. Alternatively, the bolt ace can spend 2 grit points to deal 1 point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution bleed damage (bolt ace's choice) instead. Creatures that are immune to sneak attacks are also immune to these types of bleed damage.
